## ⚠️ Instrument traps — one line each, all first-hand

- ⭐ **The shared checkout `/home/user/objectstack` is STALE and stays stale.** 2026-09-20T08:37Z: `dispatch-gates.mjs`, `label-write.mjs` and `check-half-states.mjs` **all three** differed from `origin/main`. ⛔ Blob-compare before running any of them; run from a scratch worktree reset to `origin/main`.
- ⭐⭐⭐ **THE CLAIM SHAPE.** Wrong five times this shift. `Claim:` / `Session:` / `Branch:` / `Clause-②:` each **line-initial**; a `## Claim` heading reads as UNCLAIMED. ⛔ COPY the SKILL.md template, never compose from memory. Repair is `Clause-②-correction: <claim id>`, ⛔ never a second `Claim:`.
- ⭐ **A gate cleared from ONE carrier is indistinguishable from a gate STRIPPED** — H35 caught this seat doing it on #19148 2026-09-20T08:43Z. A legal clear leaves **two** removals seconds apart.
- ⭐ **The clause-② enqueue gate has TWO limbs and either one blocks.** 辅助面/契约面 grades the CARD; the path limb reads the DIFF (`packages/spec/src/**`). A `Clause-②: no` and an owed review are **not** in conflict.
- ⭐ `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a body mixing `{{NOW}}` with a bare stamp — including one inside a **quotation**. `{{WAS:…}}` renders verbatim, so it preserves the quote exactly. ⚠️ A `{{…}}` token inside a **backtick span** prints itself; put stamps in prose.
- ⭐ **An exit code captured AFTER a pipe is `tail`'s.** Redirect to a file, capture, then read.
- ⭐ **A zero grep needs a same-SUBJECT control that hits.** Duds measured: an English pattern against a Chinese doc; a `**/*` probe matching the default spelling; a `ps` dark control self-matching; a `.refine(` count missing `.superRefine(` (75 of 126 sites).
- **`auto_merge` reads null on a PR that IS queued** — judge enqueue by `added_to_merge_queue` + the `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-N-*` branch. **`allow_merge_commit` is false here**, so an auto-merge reporting `merge` lands as a squash.
- ⭐ **A merge commit MOVES THE HEAD**, so a PASS taken before it stops naming the landing head. When the base has moved, **merge main BEFORE** dispatching the at-tier review.
- ⚠️ **A re-run reuses the original merge ref** — only a NEW commit merging `origin/main` clears a stale-base red.
- **MCP `list_issues` `labels` filter is OR, not AND.** Filter in the caller.
- `git-history.mjs touch` needs `--path=` (one path per call) and can exceed a foreground timeout; `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` REFUSES `--repo` (board comes from `PM_SWEEP_REPO`); `dispatch-gates.mjs` exits 2 where no `origin` resolves — a refusal is not a reading.
- **Run repo gates only from a COMPLETE tree** — `check-widening-tells --self-test` reads red in a `scripts/`-only tree and green (403/403) from a full worktree.
- **node's global `fetch` ignores `HTTPS_PROXY`**; the repo's scripts re-exec with `--use-env-proxy`. A raw REST `PATCH` without `Content-Type: application/json` writes NOTHING and its refusal body parses as 「I just blanked the issue」.
- ⛔ **Every GitHub payload is built from a FILE by a script** — an inline double-quoted shell string command-substituted a backtick span and corrupted a stored PR body once.
- **`git ls-remote` is the dev-liveness probe**; 45 min is the PROBE threshold, ⛔ never the death threshold. **Symlink mtimes are not the file's** — use `stat -L`.

Earlier: a label write that **overwrote the director's post-ruling action**; and twice calling a ruling pending that had already landed. ⇒ **read every comment and the timeline SINCE this seat's last action before writing any label.**
- **Family 3 — dispatch orders that cannot be obeyed.** A fence must leave a legal move; both times the devs named the conflict instead of guessing.
- **Family 4 — a debt stripped off the board.** #15646's claim shape left a CI gate red for ~7 hours while the seat rationalised it away.
- ⚠️ **Order-of-operations:** 2026-09-20T08:47Z the three-charter touch reading was taken AFTER two dispatches, and `lanes/spec.md` carried two constraints the orders were missing (辅助面 changeset 恒 patch; 契约面卡须点名消费包测试清单). Repaired forward by `SendMessage`; the ordering was still wrong.
